title: Physics-Constrained Deep Learning Model for Contactless Blood Pressure Monitoring from Triaxial Bodyseismography
abstract: arXiv:2608.23562v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ballistocardiography (BCG) is promising for unobtrusive long-term blood pressure (BP) monitoring in laboratory settings, but traditional BCG signals are vulnerable to the variations in body-bed interaction with shifted fiducial points in temporal or amplitude axis, and BP varies with personal hemodynamic changes, causing misaligned representations that affect model generalizability and robustness. In this work, we propose a non-invasive BP estimation framework, Phy-BP, based on triaxial bodyseismography (BSG) as an extension of BCG. Firstly, an adaptive quality-control algorithm is designed to select BSG segments enriched with cardiogenic components by jointly considering neighboring beat patterns and universal cardiogenic templates. translated_title: 基于物理约束的深度学习模型用于三轴体震信号无接触血压监测
translated_abstract: 心冲击图（BCG）在实验室环境中用于无干扰的长期血压（BP）监测具有前景，但传统的BCG信号易受身体与床相互作用变化的影响，导致时间或幅度轴上的特征点偏移，且血压随个人血流动力学变化而变化，造成表示不对齐，从而影响模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。在本工作中，我们提出了一种基于三轴体震信号（BSG）的非侵入性血压估计框架Phy-BP，作为BCG的扩展。首先，设计了一种自适应质量控制算法，通过联合考虑相邻心跳模式和通用心源性模板，选择富含心源性成分的BSG段。此外，建立了一个物理模型来描述身体-床系统中的三维波传播，并将其嵌入深度学习模型中，以表征三轴信号之间的内在耦合。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于三轴体震信号的物理约束深度学习模型Phy-BP，通过自适应质量控制算法和嵌入物理模型，有效解决了传统BCG信号受身体-床交互变化影响的问题，实现了更鲁棒的血压估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-constrained deep learning model Phy-BP based on triaxial bodyseismography, which uses an adaptive quality-control algorithm and embedded physical model to address body-bed interaction variations, enabling more robust blood pressure estimation.
